# Hotel Cancellation Policy

## Standard Reservations

Standard hotel reservations can be cancelled without penalty up to 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. Cancellations made less than 48 hours before check-in may be charged the first night's accommodation fee. ## Non-Refundable Reservations

Reservations marked as non-refundable cannot normally be cancelled for a refund.

In exceptional circumstances, customers may contact customer support and request a review. ## Hotel-Initiated Cancellation

If a hotel cancels a confirmed reservation, the customer will receive a full refund.
The travel platform may also assist the customer in finding alternative accommodation with similar characteristics.

# Hotel No-Show Policy

## Definition of a No-Show
A reservation is considered a no-show when the guest does not arrive on the scheduled check-in date and has not cancelled within the applicable cancellation period. ## Standard Reservations
The hotel may charge the first night's accommodation fee when the guest does not arrive and has not cancelled in time. Remaining nights may be released. ## Non-Refundable Reservations
For non-refundable reservations, the full reservation amount may remain non-refundable when the guest does not arrive. A no-show does not normally create an automatic right to a refund.

## Exceptional Circumstances
Guests who miss check-in because of exceptional circumstances may contact customer support and request a review. A review does not guarantee a refund and may require supporting documentation.

## Late Arrival
Guests expecting to arrive after normal check-in hours should contact the hotel or travel platform in advance.
Failure to notify the property may cause the reservation to be treated as a no-show.

# Travel Insurance Exclusions

## General Exclusions
Travel insurance does not cover every cancelled or interrupted trip. Coverage depends on the purchased policy, the reason for the claim, and supporting documentation. ## Known Events
Losses caused by events already known or reasonably foreseeable before insurance was purchased may be excluded. ## Change of Mind
Cancelling simply because the traveler no longer wishes to travel is normally not covered unless the policy specifically includes such protection. ## Missing Documentation
Claims may be rejected when required documentation cannot be provided.

## Hotel Cancellation Rules
Travel insurance coverage is separate from the hotel's cancellation policy. A non-refundable reservation may still be reimbursed by an eligible insurance claim, while insurance does not automatically make the hotel reservation refundable.

# Family Travel Guidelines

## Family-Friendly Hotels
Families may consider hotels with family rooms, children's pools, supervised activities, and easy access to beaches or attractions. ## Antalya Regions
Areas such as Lara, Belek, and Side include many family-oriented resorts. The best location depends on holiday type, transfer time, beach preference, and planned activities.

## Child Policies
Hotels may apply different rules for children depending on age, room occupancy, meal plans, and extra beds. ## Identification
Some properties may request identification for all guests, including children, during check-in.

## Cancellation
Family travel status does not change reservation cancellation conditions. Refund eligibility remains subject to the selected rate and applicable policy.

# Hotel Booking Policy

## Reservation Confirmation

A hotel reservation becomes confirmed after the payment process is completed and a confirmation number is issued. Customers receive the reservation details through email and the travel platform. ## Guest Information

Customers must provide accurate guest names and contact information when making a reservation. Some hotels may require identification during check-in. ## Reservation Changes

Requests to change check-in dates, guest information, or room type are subject to hotel availability and pricing rules. A reservation change may result in a price difference.

# Travel Insurance

Travel insurance may provide protection against certain unexpected events occurring before or during a trip. ## Trip Cancellation

Eligible cancellation reasons may include serious illness, injury, or other covered events defined by the insurance policy. ## Medical Coverage

Some insurance products cover emergency medical expenses incurred while travelling. Coverage limits and exclusions depend on the selected insurance product.

## Lost Baggage

Certain plans may compensate customers for baggage that is lost or significantly delayed during transportation.
Customers must provide the documents required by the insurer when making a claim.

# Antalya Travel Guide

Antalya is a major Mediterranean travel destination in Türkiye known for beaches, historical sites, and resort hotels. ## Lara

Lara is known for large resort hotels and its proximity to Antalya Airport. The area is popular with travellers looking for all-inclusive accommodation and beach access. ## Belek

Belek is well known for luxury resorts, golf facilities, and family-oriented hotels. Many resorts in Belek offer pools, children's clubs, sports facilities, and private beach access.

## Kaleici

Kaleici is Antalya's historic old town.
Visitors can explore narrow streets, historical buildings, restaurants, shops, and the old harbour.

# Payment and Charge Policy

## Reservation Payments
Hotel reservations may require full payment, partial payment, or payment at the property depending on the selected rate and hotel conditions. ## Authorization Holds
Some payment methods may show a temporary authorization hold before the final charge is completed. An authorization hold is not necessarily a completed payment.

## Duplicate Charges
Customers who believe they were charged more than once should contact customer support with the reservation number and payment details. ## Currency Conversion
Banks or card providers may apply currency conversion or international transaction fees. These charges are not hotel cancellation penalties. ## Refunds
When a refund is approved under the applicable reservation policy, it is generally returned to the original payment method. Payment processing rules do not determine refund eligibility.
# Reservation Change Policy

## Change Requests
Customers may request changes to check-in dates, check-out dates, guest information, and room type. Changes are subject to availability and the original reservation conditions. ## Price Differences
If the modified reservation is more expensive, the customer may need to pay the difference. A lower price does not automatically guarantee a refund of the difference. ## Non-Refundable Reservations
A non-refundable reservation may also be non-changeable. Some hotels may permit changes as an exception, but approval is not guaranteed. ## Cancellation vs Modification
Changing a reservation is different from cancelling it. Cancelling and creating a new booking may trigger the cancellation rules of the original reservation. ## Hotel Approval
Certain modifications require confirmation from the hotel before they become effective.
# Loyalty Program Refund Rules

## Points Earned on Refunded Reservations
Loyalty points are generally awarded only for eligible completed travel. If a reservation is fully refunded, points awarded for that reservation may be removed. ## Partial Refunds
For a partially refunded reservation, points may be recalculated based on the final eligible booking amount. ## Bookings Paid With Points
When an eligible booking paid with points is cancelled, the return of points depends on reservation conditions and loyalty rules. A non-refundable hotel rate does not automatically become refundable because points were used. ## Promotional Points
Promotional or bonus points may have separate expiration and refund rules. ## Cash Refunds

Promotional or bonus points may have separate expiration and refund rules. ## Cash Refunds
Loyalty membership does not itself create a right to a cash refund for a non-refundable hotel reservation.

# Customer Support Escalation

## Standard Support Review
Customer support can assist with reservation questions, payment issues, cancellation requests, and refund status inquiries. ## Exceptional Requests
When a customer requests an exception to a standard policy, support may escalate the case for additional review. Examples include exceptional medical situations, hotel service failures, or unusual reservation problems. ## Required Evidence
Customers may be asked to provide documents, photographs, medical records, payment records, or other evidence relevant to the request.

## No Guarantee of Approval
Escalation does not guarantee that a refund, credit, or policy exception will be approved. ## Resolution
The customer is informed when the review has been completed and any approved action has been processed.

# Loyalty Program

Members of the travel platform's loyalty program can earn points from eligible reservations. ## Earning Points

Points are calculated based on eligible booking amounts and promotional campaigns. Some discounted products may not qualify for points. ## Using Points

Customers may use available points toward eligible hotel and travel reservations. Points cannot normally be converted directly into cash.

## Membership Levels

Customers may receive different membership levels based on their travel activity. Higher membership levels may include additional campaigns, discounts, or support benefits.

# Trip Interruption Policy

## Trip Interruption
Trip interruption occurs after a traveler has already started a trip but must end it early because of an eligible event. This differs from trip cancellation, which occurs before departure. ## Potential Coverage
Depending on the insurance policy, eligible expenses may include unused prepaid travel costs and certain additional transportation expenses. ## Illness During Travel
Unexpected illness or injury during the trip may qualify when policy conditions are satisfied. Medical documentation may be required.

## Hotel Stays
Unused hotel nights may be included in an eligible insurance claim, but reimbursement is determined by the insurance provider. The hotel's own refund policy remains separate.

## Claim Review
Claims are subject to the terms, limits, exclusions, and documentation requirements of the purchased insurance policy.

# Hotel Refund Processing

## Approved Refunds
When a hotel refund has been approved, the travel platform submits the refund to the original payment method whenever possible. ## Processing Time
Refunds are normally submitted within several business days after approval. The time required for the amount to appear depends on the bank, card network, payment provider, and original payment method.

## Partial Refunds
Some cases may result in a partial refund rather than a full refund, including cancellation penalties or used portions of a stay. ## Failed Refunds
If a refund cannot be returned to the original payment method, customer support may request additional payment information or provide an alternative refund process. ## Refund Status
Customers may contact customer support when an approved refund has not appeared after the expected processing period.

# Hotel Check-In Policy

## Check-In Time
Check-in times vary by property and are displayed in the reservation information.
Early arrival does not guarantee immediate room access.

## Identification
Guests may be required to present valid identification. The reservation name should match the guest information provided during booking. ## Payment at Property
Hotels may request outstanding balances, deposits, local taxes, or incidental charges during check-in. ## Late Check-In
Guests arriving late should notify the hotel in advance when possible. Without notice, some hotels may release the room or treat the reservation as a no-show. ## Reservation Confirmation
Guests should keep their confirmation number available.
Check-in requirements are separate from refund and cancellation eligibility.
